title: Everyday Phrases — Ordering Coffee
title_quote: Excuse me, where do I order coffee?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】☕ 實用點咖啡必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Ordering Coffee
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的點咖啡情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從進門排隊點單、客製口味、等餐取餐到外帶結帳，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Ordering Coffee phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the full cafe journey: queuing and ordering, customizing your drink, waiting and pickup, takeout and checkout. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where do I order coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː wɛr du aɪ ˈɔːrdər ˈkɔːfi/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問在哪裡點咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, only two people ahead.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，前面只有兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the menu board looks huge.
dialogue.zh: 還好，菜單看板看起來好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, plenty of choices here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔːr taɪm ˈplɛnti əv ˈtʃɔɪsɪz hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the special today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm caramel latte with chopped nuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔːrm ˈkɑrəmɛl ˈlɑteɪ wɪt tʃɑpt nʌts/
dialogue.zh: 一杯加碎果仁的熱焦糖拿鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that sounds really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should try one, it is popular.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊd traɪ wʌn ɪt ɪz ˈpɑpjələr/
dialogue.zh: 你該試試，那款很受歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe later, just coffee for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, what coffee do you like?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I usually get a plain americano.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black or with a splash of milk?
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ɔːr wɪt ə sæpləʃ əv mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 要黑的還是加一點牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black, please, no sugar in it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, one plain black americano.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also see your tea list?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ si jʊr ti lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 也能看看你們的茶單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, teas are on the second board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr tiːz ɑːr ɑːn ðə ˈsɛkənd bɔːrd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，茶類在第二塊看板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the green tea looks nice there.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ɡriːn ti lʊks naɪs ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 哦，那裡的綠茶看起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fresh, sold by the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz frɛʃ soʊld baɪ ðə pɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one cup of green tea, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn kʌp əv ɡriːn ti θæŋks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, hot or over ice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot, please, it feels chilly outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice, hot tea warms you up.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑːrt tʃɔɪs hɑːt ti wɔːrmz ju ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend wants a cold drink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does she like fruity flavors?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, something with peach or mango.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The peach iced tea is very tasty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə piːtʃ aɪst ti ɪz ˈvɛri ˈteɪsti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, one big peach iced tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything else from our pastry case?
dialogue.zh: 還要從點心櫃裡點些什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What cakes do you have right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət keɪks du ju hæv raɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheese cake, chocolate cake, and carrot cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃiːz keɪk ˈtʃɑklət keɪk ænd ˈkærət keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 起司蛋糕、巧克力蛋糕和紅蘿蔔蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cheese cake looks soft and fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃiːz keɪk lʊks sɔːft ænd frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 起司蛋糕看起來又軟又新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our number one seller.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, add one cheese cake please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut and plated, or boxed to go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ænd ˈpleɪtɪd ɔːr ˈbɑkst tu ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 切片裝盤，還是裝盒帶走？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boxed is fine, we may walk around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑkst ɪz faɪn wi meɪ wɔːk əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 裝盒就好，我們會邊走邊逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will box it up soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːrfɪkt aɪ wɪl bɑks ɪt ʌp suːn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, does the cake have eggs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, baked with fresh farm eggs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No allergy, just checking for her.
dialogue.zh: 沒有過敏，只是幫她確認一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is very thoughtful of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also two napkins, we share one cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔːlsoʊ tu ˈnæpkɪnz wi ʃɛr wʌn keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 再要兩張餐巾紙，我們分一塊蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add two napkins.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one paper bag for everything?
dialogue.zh: 還是一個紙袋裝這所有東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bag comes free with your order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡ kʌmz friː wɪt jʊr ˈɔːrdər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, is the wifi free here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the password is on each cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈpæswɜːrd ɪz ɑːn iːtʃ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 免費，密碼印在每個杯子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then we can wait inside.
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，我們可以在店裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, seating is upstairs and in back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsiːtɪŋ ɪz ˌʌpˈstɛrz ænd ɪn bæk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it busy at this hour?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The morning rush just ended.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky us, quiet shop and warm drinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ʌs ˈkwaɪət ʃɑːp ænd wɔːrm drɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 我們真幸運，店裡安靜又有熱飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose any table you like.
dialogue.zh: 喜歡哪張桌子就坐哪張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table by the window looks cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈteɪbl baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ lʊks ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那張桌子看起來很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great pick, it gets soft sunlight.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，那裡有柔和的陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will take the corner seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your order number is forty-two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I will watch the number screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə ˈnʌmbər skriːn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我會盯著叫號螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or listen, we call each order aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr ˈlɪsən wi kɔːl iːtʃ ˈɔːrdər əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 也可以聽聲音，我們會喊單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please call it slowly, the music is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz kɔːl ɪt ˈsloʊli ðə ˈmjuːzɪk ɪz ˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 請喊慢一點，音樂有點大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we repeat every number twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwʌriz wi rɪˈpiːt ˈɛvri ˈnʌmbər kwaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，每個號碼我們會喊兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, one americano, one hot green tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌn əˈmɛrɪkənoʊ wʌn hɑːt ɡriːn ti/
dialogue.zh: 所以是一杯美式、一杯熱綠茶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the iced peach tea too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ði aɪst piːtʃ ti tuː/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one cheese cake to go.
dialogue.zh: 外加一塊起司蛋糕帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the whole list.
dialogue.zh: 就這些，全在這張單上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything warm for your friend?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, she always drinks cold ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, iced only for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, are refills free?
dialogue.zh: 順便問一下，續杯免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for brewed coffee, not for lattes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔːr bruːd ˈkɔfi nɑt fɔːr ˈlɑteɪz/
dialogue.zh: 只有煮好的黑咖啡可續，拿鐵不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep free water?
dialogue.zh: 免費的飲用水放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the door, cups and ice included.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔːr kʌps ænd aɪs ɪnˈkluːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 在門邊，杯子和冰塊都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, one less thing to order.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，那就又少點一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, let me finish writing first.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊd ɑːn lɛt mi ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈraɪtɪŋ fɜːrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will that take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten minutes for all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts fɔːr ɔl əv ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fine, we have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We brew every coffee fresh to order.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bruː ˈɛvri ˈkɔfi frɛʃ tu ˈɔːrdər/
dialogue.zh: 我們的咖啡都是現點現做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, fresh always tastes better.
dialogue.zh: 好，新鮮的總是比較好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, see you at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, what goes on the cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need your name for the cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ niːd jʊːr neɪm fɔːr ðə kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 我要在杯子上寫您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is Ben, B E N.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben, short and easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People misspell it all the time.
dialogue.zh: 人們老是把我的名字拼錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I promise I will spell it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prəˈmɪs aɪ wɪl spɛl ɪt raɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my friend is Anna.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A, double N, then A?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, you learn fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will draw a smile on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl drɔ ə smaɪl ɑːn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會在她杯上畫個笑臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She loves little doodles like that.
dialogue.zh: 她最喜歡這種小塗鴉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The smile is on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I go, one small thing.
dialogue.zh: 正要走之前，還有點小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, what is on your mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔrs wət ɪz ɑːn jʊːr maɪnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I make my drink special?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把我的飲品客制一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell me every change you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛl mi ˈɛvri tʃeɪndʒ ju wɑːnt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，想改哪裡都告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I like to tweak things.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are happy to build it your way.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑːr ˈhæpi tu bɪld ɪt jʊːr weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們很樂意照您的喜好做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start with the americano.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, size first, then extras.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sizes do you have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small, medium, large, and a huge one.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔːl ˈmiːdiəm ˈlɑːrdʒ ænd ə hjuːdʒ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 小杯、中杯、大杯，還有超大杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The medium cup is enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːdiəm kʌp ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔːr mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium americano, coming right up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend always orders the large one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ˈɔlweɪz ˈɔːrdərz ðə ˈlɑːrdʒ wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Large peach tea, got that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is the small one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small fits eight ounces exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green tea for me is medium.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡriːn ti fɔːr mi ɪz ˈmiːdiəm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium hot tea, simple order.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, I want that caramel latte too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli aɪ wɑːnt ðæt ˈkɑrəmɛl ˈlɑteɪ tuː/
dialogue.zh: 其實，那杯焦糖拿鐵我也想要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice, milk or no milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have oat milk today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it adds a small charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fine, use oat milk in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn juːz oʊt mɪlk ɪn ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oat makes lattes creamy, good pick.
dialogue.zh: 燕麥奶讓拿鐵更綿密，選得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my americano still just black?
dialogue.zh: 我的美式還是純黑的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, black and strong as before.
dialogue.zh: 對，跟您要的一樣，純黑又濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almond milk too? My friend likes it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑmənd mɪlk tu maɪ frɛnd laɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 也有杏仁奶嗎？我朋友喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep almond milk in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kiːp ˈɑmənd mɪlk ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about milk on the side for tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt mɪlk ɑːn ðə saɪd fɔːr ti/
dialogue.zh: 茶可以另外附一包奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can serve milk in a small jug.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn sɜːrv mɪlk ɪn ə smɔːl dʒʌɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I like to taste first.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我喜歡先嚐原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, then add milk little by little.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑːrt ðɛn æd mɪlk ˈlɪtl baɪ ˈlɪtl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you make the latte extra hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju meɪk ðə ˈlɑteɪ ˈɛkstrə hɑːt/
dialogue.zh: 拿鐵可以做得更燙一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, steamed longer for more heat.
dialogue.zh: 可以，牛奶多蒸一會兒就更燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or maybe light ice in the iced tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr ˈmeɪbi laɪt aɪs ɪn ði aɪst ti/
dialogue.zh: 或者冰茶裡的冰放少一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light ice, more tea, less water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please make the peach tea not too sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz meɪk ðə piːtʃ ti nɑt tu swiːt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half sweet, does that work?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, half sweetness for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will mark the cup clearly.
dialogue.zh: 我會在杯子上清楚標記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What syrups do you offer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vanilla, caramel, hazelnut, and mint.
dialogue.zh: 香草、焦糖、榛果還有薄荷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add one pump of vanilla, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pump vanilla, barely sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pumps is too many?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three pumps suit a medium cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then two pumps of caramel on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tuː pʌmps əv ˈkɑrəmɛl ɑːn tɑp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Caramel latte, yum, nice idea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No whipped cream, I have a sore throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɪpt kriːm aɪ hæv ə sɔːr θroʊt/
dialogue.zh: 不要鮮奶油，我喉嚨有點痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cream on top, understood.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get extra foam on mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ˈɛkstrə foʊm ɑːn maɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fluffy foam, coming up.
dialogue.zh: 可以，綿密的奶泡馬上好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add a shot to my latte?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd ə ʃɑːt tu maɪ ˈlɑteɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拿鐵裡能加一份濃縮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, one shot adds extra strength.
dialogue.zh: 可以，加一份濃縮會更有勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I choose decaf coffee?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Decaf tastes almost the same.
dialogue.zh: 低因的喝起來幾乎一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make the afternoon latte decaf, please.
dialogue.zh: 下午那杯拿鐵請做低因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, decaf helps you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her iced tea can be extra cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ aɪst ti kæn bi ˈɛkstrə koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 她的冰茶要做更冰一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will fill it with extra ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl fɪl ɪt wɪð ˈɛkstrə aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我會多放幾塊冰在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No lemon in the tea, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, plain tea unless you ask.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please serve the tea a bit cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz sɜːrv ðə ti ə bɪt ˈkuːlər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm not scalding, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔːrm nɑt ˈskɔldɪŋ aɪ kæn du ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have honey in the coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈhʌni ɪn ðə ˈkɔfi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stir honey into drinks here.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以幫飲品拌進蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honey in my americano, why not?
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜加我的美式，何樂不為？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is not common, but it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɑt ˈkɑmən bʌt ɪt wɜːrks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mix the honey all the way in.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪks ðə ˈhʌni ɔːl ðə weɪ ɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will stir twice to be safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɜːr kwaɪs tu bi seɪf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cinnamon dust on top of the latte?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪnəmən dʌst ɑːn tɑp əv ðə ˈlɑteɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拿鐵上面撒點肉桂粉好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cinnamon on caramel is a classic.
dialogue.zh: 焦糖配肉桂是很經典的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, dust it lightly, not too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʌst ɪt ˈlaɪtli nɑt tuː mʌtʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little dusting, just enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cheese cake need cream too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə tʃiːz keɪk niːd kriːm tuː/
dialogue.zh: 起司蛋糕也要再配奶油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the cake is rich already.
dialogue.zh: 不用，蛋糕本身夠濃郁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then no extra sauce on it.
dialogue.zh: 那就別在上面另外淋醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain box, no sauce inside.
dialogue.zh: 素麵盒裝好，裡面不加醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, swap the cake for a cookie.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt swɔːp ðə keɪk fɔːr ə ˈkʊki/
dialogue.zh: 等等，把蛋糕換成餅乾吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have oat raisin and chocolate chip.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv oʊt ˈreɪzɪn ænd ˈtʃɑklɪt tʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 有葡萄乾燕麥和巧克力豆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two chocolate chip cookies, warm ones.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊巧克力豆餅乾，要熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We warm them for thirty seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, we like them soft.
dialogue.zh: 時間剛正好，我們喜歡軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft and melty, the best part.
dialogue.zh: 鬆軟微融，那才是最棒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please cut the cookies in half.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut halves make sharing easy.
dialogue.zh: 切一半，兩個人分剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my iced tea come without a straw?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ aɪst ti kʌm wɪˈðaʊt ə strɔː/
dialogue.zh: 我的冰茶可以不放吸管嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use paper straws now anyway.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在一律改用紙吸管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A paper straw works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lasts about an hour in tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt læsts əˈbaʊt an ˈaʊər ɪn ti/
dialogue.zh: 泡在茶裡大約撐一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is plenty, my tea goes fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti maɪ ti ɡoʊz fæst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a lid on the hot tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑːnt ə lɪd ɑːn ðə hɑːt ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a loose lid, let steam out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə luːs lɪd lɛt stiːm aʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose lid on the green tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a cardboard sleeve for it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleeves are free, no need to ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /sliːvz ɑːr friː noʊ niːd tu æsk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my latte big or medium?
dialogue.zh: 我的拿鐵是大杯還是中杯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said medium earlier, still okay?
dialogue.zh: 您剛才點的是中杯，沒變吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium is perfect for the latte.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium latte with extra foam and cinnamon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiːdiəm ˈlɑteɪ wɪð ˈɛkstrə foʊm ænd ˈsɪnəmən/
dialogue.zh: 中杯拿鐵，加多奶泡和肉桂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remembered every change!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I write them on each cup label.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ raɪt ðɛm ɑːn iːtʃ kʌp ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它們寫在杯標上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend will love her labeled cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd wɪl lʌv hɚ ˈleɪbld kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友會喜歡她寫好字的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anna, iced peach tea, half sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one tiny last change.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I have not started yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪ hæv nɑt ˈstɑːrtɪd jɛt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add one butter biscuit as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, your order is now complete.
dialogue.zh: 好了，您的訂單全部完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number forty-two is almost up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the screen just blinked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did someone call forty-two?
dialogue.zh: 是有人在喊四十二號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there are your drinks, Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That smell pulled us to the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smɛl pʊld ʌs tu ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 那香味把我們拉到了取餐台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pickup is on the left side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see our cups on the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ˈaʊər kʌps ɑːn ðə mæt/
dialogue.zh: 我看到我們的杯子放在墊子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the names before you grab.
dialogue.zh: 拿之前先核對一下名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben and Anna, all correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, no misspelling today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep sugar and cream?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju kiːp ˈʃʊɡər ænd kriːm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little table with all toppings.
dialogue.zh: 放滿配料的那張小桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it called a condiment bar?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sugar, milk, stirrers, napkins.
dialogue.zh: 對，糖、奶、攪拌棒、紙巾都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown sugar or white sugar?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, plus zero calorie packets.
dialogue.zh: 兩種都有，還有零卡糖包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I take one white sugar cube.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dissolves slow, good for sipping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stirrer sticks are right beside them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wooden ones, better for the planet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will stir my honey coffee now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɜːr maɪ ˈhʌni ˈkɔfi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在來攪我的蜂蜜咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the cup is very hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need cream in my tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ niːd kriːm ɪn maɪ ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taste it first before you decide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the tea tastes clean without milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ti teɪsts kliːn wɪˈðaʊt mɪlk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then save the milk for later.
dialogue.zh: 那就先把奶留著之後用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra napkins for the sticky spoon.
dialogue.zh: 多拿張紙巾擦黏黏的勺子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack them by the sugar jars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One napkin, then a stirrer too.
dialogue.zh: 一張紙巾，再拿一根攪棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at you, a coffee scientist.
dialogue.zh: 瞧您這架勢，像個咖啡科學家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I just like things exact.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little sugar changes everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they restock the sugar often?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every morning, never runs out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my lid just came off.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ nɑː maɪ lɪd dʒʌst keɪm ɔːf/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我的杯蓋剛剛掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, a new lid, all fixed.
dialogue.zh: 給，換個新蓋子就搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that was quick service.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lids pop off, it happens daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cookies cooled down too much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the microwave for ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you warm them one more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wɔːrm ðɛm wʌn mɔːr taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, two minutes at most.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While we wait, look at that art.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl wi weɪt lʊk æt ðæt ɑːrt/
dialogue.zh: 等的時候，看牆上那幅畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Local painters trade art for coffee.
dialogue.zh: 本地畫家用作品換咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a clever way to decorate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The walls change every season.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every new season brings us back.
dialogue.zh: 每換一季，我們就想回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you will see the winter set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju wɪl si ðə ˈwɪntər sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那到了冬天你們就看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your iced tea sweats all over the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊːr aɪst ti swɛts ɔːl ˈoʊvər ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你的冰茶把袋子都弄濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slip a napkin under the cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, paper bags get soggy fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ˈpeɪpər bæɡz ɡɛt ˈsɑɡi fæst/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，紙袋一下就被浸軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic bags stop every drip.
dialogue.zh: 塑膠袋能擋住所有水滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We try to avoid plastic, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過我們盡量避開塑膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the napkin trick is your friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈnæpkɪn trɪk ɪz jʊːr frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那紙巾的小妙招正好幫上忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna, here is your half sweet tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə hɪr ɪz jʊːr hæf swiːt ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like a summer orchard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sip slow, they made it extra cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪp sloʊ ðeɪ meɪd ɪt ˈɛkstrə koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢喝，他們做得特別冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bless them, my favorite drink ever.
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了，我的最愛飲品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did they forget my cookies?
dialogue.zh: 等等，他們忘了我的餅乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at the whole tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk æt ðə hoʊl treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我來檢查一下整個托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the cookie box is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waited under your cup.
dialogue.zh: 它一直放在你杯子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silly me, relief tastes like coffee.
dialogue.zh: 我真傻，安心的味道像咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relief, ha, I like that phrase.
dialogue.zh: 安心的味道，哈，我喜歡這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This foam is high like a cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs foʊm ɪz haɪ laɪk ə klaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 這奶泡高高得像一朵雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Baristas call it a perfect dome.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡師叫它完美的圓頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dome of foam, too pretty to drink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə doʊm əv foʊm tuː ˈpɪti tu drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 圓頂奶泡，美得捨不得喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink it before the cloud falls.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cinnamon smells like my grandmother's kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪnəmən smɛlz laɪk maɪ ˈɡrænˌmɑːðərz ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我的肉桂香得像奶奶的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm smells carry the best memories.
dialogue.zh: 溫暖的香氣帶著最好的回憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One biscuit for me, two for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbɪskɪt fɔːr mi tu fɔːr ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three treats, fair split, done.
dialogue.zh: 三樣點心，這樣分剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these cookies have nuts inside?
dialogue.zh: 這些餅乾裡面有堅果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours are nut free, safe for all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərz ɑːr nʌt friː seɪf fɔːr ɔːl/
dialogue.zh: 我們的不含堅果，誰都能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love those mugs over there.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡那邊那幾只馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ceramic keeps drinks warmer.
dialogue.zh: 陶瓷杯讓飲品保溫更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy those mugs here?
dialogue.zh: 我們能在這裡買那種杯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the shelf by the register.
dialogue.zh: 可以，就在收銀機旁的架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab two as a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡræb tuː æz ə ɡɪft/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They pack nicely in small boxes.
dialogue.zh: 它們用小盒子裝很好送人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This straw wrapper is paper too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel it before it gets wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I almost missed it.
dialogue.zh: 好提醒，我差點沒注意到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people learn it the wet way.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpiːpl lɜːrn ɪt ðə wɛt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大多數人都是喝濕了才學會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our table is still free, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nobody took your spot.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，沒人佔你們的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, the corner seat is ours.
dialogue.zh: 呼，角落那個位子還是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your cups, I will save them.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jʊːr kʌps aɪ wɪl seɪv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 把杯子端過去，我幫你看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing at the bar.
dialogue.zh: 調味台那邊還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, what do you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any sweetener drops?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little bottles, next to the honey.
dialogue.zh: 有小瓶裝，就在蜂蜜旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two drops are enough for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny drop, a big flavor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they get every change right?
dialogue.zh: 他們每一處都改對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taste again, then tell me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The peach tea tastes really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip it slowly, the taste stays longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪp ɪt ˈsloʊli ðə ˈteɪst steɪz ˈlɔːŋɡər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The music changed, this song is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmjuːzɪk tʃeɪndʒd ðɪs sɔːŋ ɪz naɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This shop always picks good songs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come on, let us try the sofa corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ɑːn lɛt ʌs traɪ ðə ˈsoʊfə ˈkɔːrnər/
dialogue.zh: 走吧，我們去沙發那區坐坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, past the counter, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pæst ðə ˈkaʊntər ɑːn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 對，過了收銀台，在左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sofas by the fireplace look comfy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsoʊfəz baɪ ðə ˈfaɪərˌpleɪs lʊk ˈkɑːmfi/
dialogue.zh: 壁爐邊的沙發看起來好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, those seats are the coziest.
dialogue.zh: 是的，那幾個位子最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will sit on the big sofa.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl sɪt ɑːn ðə bɪɡ ˈsoʊfə/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will grab water and two cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡræb ˈwɔːtər ænd tuː kʌps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can actually talk here.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，在這兒能好好聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The music stays low on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I added a latte for my sister.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ əˈdɪd ə ˈlɑteɪ fɔːr maɪ ˈsɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 我另外加了一杯拿鐵，幫妹妹帶的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her latte will stay warm.
dialogue.zh: 她的拿鐵會一直保持溫熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lid tight for the walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə lɪd taɪt fɔːr ðə wɔːk/
dialogue.zh: 走路的話杯蓋扣得緊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snap it twice, then test it.
dialogue.zh: 按兩下扣緊，再檢查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No spills so far, good design.
dialogue.zh: 到現在沒灑出來，設計不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We test every new cup shape.
dialogue.zh: 每款新杯型我們都試過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two napkins and a spoon, please.
dialogue.zh: 請給兩張紙巾和一把勺子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spoons hang in that little rack.
dialogue.zh: 勺子掛在那個小架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spoon is for the soft cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spuːn ɪz fɔːr ðə sɔːft ˈkʊkɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這把勺是用來挖軟餅乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fork would suit them better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a dozen cookies?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dozen comes boxed and tied.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do they keep fresh?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, sealed, no fridge.
dialogue.zh: 密封可放三天，不用冷藏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is plenty for a gift.
dialogue.zh: 當禮物送人時間完全夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a ribbon, it looks fancy.
dialogue.zh: 加條緞帶，看起來很精緻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take the ribbon too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red or gold bows today?
dialogue.zh: 今天蝴蝶結要紅還是金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gold looks great on the box.
dialogue.zh: 金色配這個紙盒很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on its way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try one cookie, they go with anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ wʌn ˈkʊki ðeɪ ɡoʊ wɪð ˈɛnɪθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嚐一塊餅乾，它們配什麼都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One crunchy, one creamy, good coffee combo.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkrʌnʃi wʌn ˈkriːmi ɡʊd ˈkɔːfi kəmˈboʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一脆一滑，跟咖啡真是絕配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wifi strong in this corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ strɔːŋ ɪn ðɪs ˈkɔːrnər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong enough for videos, no worries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charging my phone, the outlet works.
dialogue.zh: 手機充電中，插座是好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outlets sit under every table.
dialogue.zh: 每張桌子下面都有插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place truly thinks of everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfort keeps guests coming back.
dialogue.zh: 舒適感讓客人一再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I look at the pastry list?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ lʊk æt ðə ˈpeɪstri lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 我能再看一下點心單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is taped to the case glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz teɪpt tu ðə keɪs ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 單子貼在展示櫃玻璃上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Banana bread sounds good with tea.
dialogue.zh: 香蕉麵包配茶聽起來很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is baked fresh this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One slice of banana bread, yes.
dialogue.zh: 來一片香蕉麵包，就這麼定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm slice, butter on top?
dialogue.zh: 熱的一片，上面抹奶油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Butter melts right into banana bread.
dialogue.zh: 奶油會慢慢化進麵包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a thin layer of butter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the banana bread?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three fifty for one warm slice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash only? Or can I tap?
dialogue.zh: 只收現金嗎？還是能感應付款？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards and phones both work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap is fastest, here we go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Approved, the machine says yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get the receipt by text?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ðə rɪˈsiːt baɪ tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 收據可以傳簡訊給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it arrives in about a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪt əˈraɪvz ɪn əˈbaʊt ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，大約一分鐘就送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my total twenty dollars?
dialogue.zh: 我總共要付二十美元嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty two with the banana bread.
dialogue.zh: 加上香蕉麵包是二十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can split the bill, Anna.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pay for my own tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl peɪ fɔːr maɪ ˈoʊn ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You paid already? That was fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teamwork makes the coffee line short.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a tip jar here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits beside the register bell.
dialogue.zh: 小費罐就在收銀鈴旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small tip for great service.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too kind, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this bread made with real fruit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs brɛd meɪd wɪð rɪəl fruːt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three bananas go into every loaf.
dialogue.zh: 每條麵包都放三根香蕉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real banana, no fake flavor then.
dialogue.zh: 真香蕉，那就沒有假香精。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We never use flavor powder here.
dialogue.zh: 我們這兒從不用香精粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you toss these boxes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue bin for paper, clear for cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /bluː bɪn fɔːr ˈpeɪpər klɪr fɔːr kʌps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorting trash feels easy with signs.
dialogue.zh: 有這些指示，分類很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to waste very little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time tomorrow for coffee, then?
dialogue.zh: 那明天同一時間來喝咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I bring my sister too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her the banana bread awaits.
dialogue.zh: 告訴她香蕉麵包在等她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will order two slices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a loyalty card here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈlɔɪəlti kɑːrd hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten coffees, then one is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign me up, I drink daily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your card, stamp it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jʊːr kɑːrd stæmp ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 卡給您，現在就蓋第一個章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the card work at other shops?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə kɑːrd wɜːrk æt ˈʌðər ʃɑps/
dialogue.zh: 這卡在別的分店也能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any shop in our city.
dialogue.zh: 能，我們全城分店都通用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our city needs more good cafes.
dialogue.zh: 我們城市需要更多好咖啡館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you come to this corner often?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju kʌm tu ðɪs ˈkɔːrnər ˈɔːfən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are new to this neighborhood.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you live nearby then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, just around the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you are our newest regulars.
dialogue.zh: 那你們就是我們的新常客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will be here every week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will remember your two names.
dialogue.zh: 我會記住你們兩個的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben and Anna, easy to spell.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, welcome to the family.
dialogue.zh: 記好了，歡迎成為這裡的一分子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really did remember them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Names are a barista's treasure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last sip is always sad.
dialogue.zh: 喝完最後一口總是有點傷感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save room, tomorrow has lattes.
dialogue.zh: 留點肚子，明天還有拿鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, we will be back tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh beans arrive every Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 每週四都會到貨新鮮豆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday? Then we plan for Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday is truly the best day.
dialogue.zh: 週四真的是最棒的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodbyes are hard with good coffee.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡太好喝，道別都變難了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you soon, both of you.
dialogue.zh: 很快再見，你們兩個都要來。
